answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The cedar holds work receipts rather than names, so the canyon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The prism of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
